crossRefs.note: Hathach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.

people.name: Esther
people.line: Jewish queen of Persia; saved her people from genocide.

people.name: Hathach
people.line: A eunuch in the court of King Ahasuerus.

people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

translations.web: Hathach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.
translations.bsb: So Hathach went back and relayed Mordecai’s response to Esther.
translations.kjv: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.
translations.asv: And Hathach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.
